subject: Linguistics
title: Noun Phrases
description: A fast breakdown of Noun Phrases for builders.

hook.text: 'The very tall man in the hat' is seven words—but it fills one noun-sized slot.

buildup.text: A noun phrase is built around a noun head with optional determiners, adjectives, and modifiers.

discovery.text: NPs can be as short as a pronoun ('she') or as long as a paragraph in legal writing.

twist.text: Japanese noun phrases put modifiers before the noun; English allows both positions.

climax.text: NPs fill subject, object, and complement slots—they're the workhorses of every sentence.

punchline.text: One phrase, any size, one noun job.

quiz.question: What is the head of a noun phrase?
